facts.fact: The FEC reports the Startup Act, Ordonnance-loi n° 22/030 of 8 September 2022, is the basis for a national startup labelling committee created by Decree n° 26/022 of 5 June 2026, which met for the first time on 4 November 2026.

systems.system: Comite National de Labellisation des startups

COD.note: No startup is yet stated as labelled; the committee has only held its first meeting.
